title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Job Title: Flutter Developer**  

We are looking for a skilled and proactive **Flutter Developer** to join our team.  

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of mobile UI development and hands\-on experience with deploying apps to both the **Google Play Store** and **Apple App Store.**  

You will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining high\-quality cross\-platform (Android \& iOS) mobile applications, while ensuring excellent user experiences and performance. **Required Skills and Qualifications:**  

* Proficient in Flutter for cross\-platform (Android \& iOS) **mobile app development**
* Strong understanding of mobile UI design principles and best practices
* Experience publishing and managing apps on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store (including Play Console and App Store Connect/TestFlight workflows)
* Familiarity with **Firebase** (including Authentication, Cloud Fire store, and FCM)
* Demonstrated ability to improve app performance and user experience based on feedback
* Basic understanding of native **Android (Kotlin/Java)** and **iOS (Swift/Objective\-C)** development is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and team collaboration skills

title: iOS Developer
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Fresher iOS Developer** to join our development team. The candidate will work on building, testing, and maintaining iOS applications while learning and applying modern iOS development practices.

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain iOS applications using **Swift** and **Xcode**.
* Build user\-friendly interfaces using **UIKit and/or SwiftUI**.
* Work with **REST APIs** and integrate backend services.
* Implement application features based on business and technical requirements.
* Debug issues and fix bugs to improve application performance and stability.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Perform testing and support application releases.
* Collaborate with designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and other team members.
* Stay updated with the latest iOS development technologies and best practices.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Swift**.
* Familiarity with **Xcode** and iOS development.
* Understanding of **UIKit or SwiftUI**.
* Basic knowledge of **REST APIs and JSON**.
* Understanding of **Git/GitHub**.
* Knowledge of object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Basic understanding of iOS application lifecycle and debugging.
* Good problem\-solving and communication skills.

Good to Have

* Personal or academic iOS projects.
* Knowledge of **Core Data, URLSession, or Firebase**.
* Familiarity with **MVVM or other design patterns**.
* Knowledge of App Store submission and TestFlight.
* Internship or project experience in iOS development.

Education

**B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / equivalent degree** in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real\-world iOS applications.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Exposure to modern iOS technologies.
* Learning and career\-growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.

Pay: Up to ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
